keySentence: He cleverly tricked friends into working.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: More friends came and wanted to paint. They gave Tom gifts. Tom sat and watched. He cleverly tricked friends into working.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: One by one, more boys from the neighborhood came to watch. Each one begged for a chance to paint the beautiful fence. He cleverly tricked friends into working by making it look special. They even paid Tom with marbles, kites, and other treasures. Tom sat under the tree enjoying his pile of new presents. By afternoon, the whole fence was painted three coats thick.
